definitions.explanation: A landscape or view covered in snow. Evokes a sense of beauty and tranquility.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}から{雪景色|ゆきげしき}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: I can see a snowy landscape from the window.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}の{雪景色|ゆきげしき}は{本当|ほんとう}に{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The snowy scenery of Hokkaido is truly beautiful.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}に{浸|つ}かりながら{雪景色|ゆきげしき}を{楽|たの}しむのは{最高|さいこう}のぜいたくだ。
examples.english: Soaking in a hot spring while enjoying the snowy scenery is the ultimate luxury.

notes:
A compound of {雪|ゆき} (snow) + {景色|けしき} (scenery). The reading changes from けしき to げしき due to rendaku (sequential voicing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雪景色|ゆきげしき}を{眺|なが}める (gaze at snowy scenery)
- {雪景色|ゆきげしき}を{楽|たの}しむ (enjoy snowy scenery)
- {一面|いちめん}の{雪景色|ゆきげしき} (a landscape covered entirely in snow)

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS:
- {夜景|やけい} (night view)
- {紅葉|こうよう} (autumn foliage scenery)
- {花見|はなみ} (cherry blossom viewing — an activity, not just scenery)
